prescriptions.guidance: Demonstrations should reinforce committing to the Top-edge corridor early when central rows contain fires, showing how to stay on row 0 and descend along the goal column without detouring into hazardous regions.
prescriptions.target_region: Start positions near the top rows with central fires present; goal placed within reach via top-edge path.
prescriptions.what_it_teaches: Reliable fire avoidance and decisive corridor commitment within the Top-edge corridor when central fires are present.

prescriptions.guidance: Demonstrations should emphasize rapid commitment to the Top-edge corridor to prevent wandering, particularly in tasks where central fires could tempt detours.
prescriptions.target_region: Start near top-middle with goal positioned to require descent along the top-edge path.
prescriptions.what_it_teaches: Reduces timeout by teaching the agent to stick to a single corridor from the start when fires are present.

recommended_layouts.rationale: Illustrates top-edge commitment even as fires appear near the middle-right; addresses the timeout observed in episodes 4 and 9.

prescriptions.guidance: For infeasible-corridor cases, help the agent recognize when no safe corridor path exists and avoid continuing the search unnecessarily.
prescriptions.target_region: Representative infeasible configuration near Episode 7’s description.
prescriptions.what_it_teaches: Recognize infeasibility under corridor constraints and avoid futile wandering.
